schema.name: pixl_plar_handoff
schema.description: Save an exact selected-production continuation with agent-authored details. view=caller returns bounded assignment, files, issues and integration observations beside derived state and exact detail/resume references; default receipt unchanged. No acceptance or provider action. Optional result_path saves the exact full JSON under a fresh project-relative path and returns a compact path/hash summary.

requirements_hash.description: Selected semantic requirements digest from pixl_plar_read.requirements_hash; not the PLAR file hash.

expect.description: Current production.continuation.state_hash from selected pixl_plar_read; not the PLAR file hash.
